description: The mutually exclusive counting bucket of one eligible deduped mention. Every eligible deduped mention enters exactly one bucket, by deterministic priority from source eligibility to shard completeness to intent assignment. Source: PDT v1.3.1 §6.6 and §9.3.

bucket.description: published_classified: in the formal denominator. none_unknown: Jev Choice None or Noul gate rejected. review_pending: low confidence, awaiting human review. partial_or_schema_gap: shard failed or Score probabilities missing. pending_parent: intent has no confirmed primary task category. other_pending: any other pending state.

mention_id.description: The mention this bucket assignment belongs to

title: Counting Bucket
